keys.ragnarok: ragnar[oö]k|end of the world|twilight of the gods|the day you rise|rise from the (sea|deep)

lines.opener: *far below, in black water, an eye the size of a cathedral door opens* ............ Too small. *the eye begins, very slowly, to close*
lines.openerHostile: *the whole cavern shudders as a coil the width of a river heaves out of the water* .......... You smell of thunder, speck. Of HIM.
lines.like: *a long, rumbling exhale ripples across the water* ........ Yesss. Go on.
lines.dislike: *venom hisses where it drips onto the rocks* ......... Do not.
lines.hate: *the sea rises in a wall* HOOKED? LIKE A FISH? *a head the size of a longship comes down on you*
lines.flirt: *a slow, enormous blink* ............ You are a speck.
lines.join: *the coils shift, and the tide goes out* .......... Interesting. You are interesting. I will come and see what you do. Until the day.
lines.demand: *the vast nostrils flare* ......... I smell beef. An ox head. Give it. I know. I know what happened last time. Give it anyway.
lines.gift: *a scale as big as a shield drifts up out of the dark water and grounds at your feet* .......... Something to remember the world by.
lines.thanks: *a contented rumble that shakes the walls* ........ Good.
lines.letPass: *the eye closes all the way* .......... Pass, speck. Wake me at the end of the world.
lines.neutral: *the water heaves slowly in and out, like breathing*
lines.ai: *a very long pause* .......... What is that. It sounds small.
lines.refuseJoin: ......... No. I hold the world. I am busy.
lines.leaveNow: *the coils slide away into the deep, and the water goes flat and black* ...........
